title: Dispatch Tool Call
description: Route a tool call to the server that owns it.
signature: pub fn call(&self, app: &AppHandle, id: &str, tool: &str, params: Option<Value>, dev_mode: bool) -> Result<ToolAnswer, RpcError>
errors: METHOD_NOT_FOUND when server or tool is unknown
semantics: Looks up the server and tool, validates both, then calls the handler with the lock released.
